results.name: NQ01_total_matches
results.question: How many matches are in Pakistan's cricket history dataset?
results.ground_truth_note: Must equal the number of JSON files ingested from cricsheet. Full Pakistan corpus = 1,123 men's matches.

results.name: NQ02_total_players
results.question: How many unique players (both Pakistani and opponents) are in the dataset?
results.ground_truth_note: Full corpus: ~1,920 players. Must include Pakistani players AND every opponent player Pakistan has faced.

results.name: NQ03_test_match_count
results.question: How many Test matches did Pakistan play?
results.ground_truth_note: Pakistan has played ~450+ Tests historically. This corpus covers the digitized cricsheet matches only.

results.name: NQ04_venue_count
results.question: How many distinct venues have hosted Pakistan matches?
results.ground_truth_note: Full corpus: 210 venues. Includes domestic and overseas grounds where Pakistan has played.

results.name: NQ05_top_test_run_scorers
results.question: Who are Pakistan's top-5 Test match run-scorers of all time?
results.ground_truth_note: Younis Khan leads all Pakistan Test batters with 10,099 runs. Inzamam-ul-Haq (~8,830) and Mohammad Yousuf (~7,530) follow. Misbah-ul-Haq (~5,222) and Azhar Ali (~7,142) also in top 5.

results.name: NQ06_top_t20_six_hitters
results.question: Who hit the most sixes in Pakistan's T20 international matches?
results.ground_truth_note: Shahid Afridi is Pakistan's all-time T20I six-hitting champion; Babar Azam and Mohammad Hafeez also feature prominently.

results.name: NQ07_top_wicket_takers
results.question: Who are the top-5 overall wicket-takers across all formats in this dataset?
results.ground_truth_note: Wasim Akram, Waqar Younis, and Shahid Afridi are historically Pakistan's top wicket-takers. Imran Khan also features. Result depends on which formats are included in the corpus.

results.name: NQ08_top_odi_fours_pakistan
results.question: Which Pakistani batters scored the most boundaries (fours) in ODI cricket?
results.ground_truth_note: Saeed Anwar was famous for elegant boundaries. Inzamam-ul-Haq, Mohammad Hafeez, and Babar Azam are also prolific ODI boundary-scorers.

results.name: NQ09_avg_runs_conceded_test_pak
results.question: What is the average runs conceded per match by Pakistani bowlers in Test cricket?
results.ground_truth_note: Economy-oriented spinners (e.g., Saqlain Mushtaq, Danish Kaneria) should appear near the top. Pace bowlers (Wasim, Waqar) concede more runs per match but also take more wickets.

results.name: NQ10_batters_at_karachi
results.question: Which players have batted the most times in matches played at Karachi?
results.ground_truth_note: National Stadium, Karachi is Pakistan's home fortress. Pakistani players (Inzamam, Younis, Salman Butt) dominate due to frequent home appearances.

results.name: NQ11_matches_at_dubai_venues
results.question: How many matches were played at each venue in Dubai?
results.ground_truth_note: Dubai International Cricket Stadium is Pakistan's de-facto home. The dataset shows it hosted 100+ Pakistan matches.

results.name: NQ12_bowlers_at_abu_dhabi
results.question: Which bowlers took the most wickets in matches played at Abu Dhabi?
results.ground_truth_note: Saeed Ajmal, Junaid Khan, and Mohammad Hafeez performed well at Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi — Pakistan's frequent neutral venue.

results.name: NQ13_matches_per_tournament
results.question: Which tournaments featured the most matches in the dataset?
results.ground_truth_note: Asia Cup, ICC World Cup, and Champions Trophy series should top the list alongside bilateral series (Pakistan vs Australia, etc.).

results.name: NQ14_all_rounders_by_dual_match_count
results.question: Which players contributed to both batting and bowling in the most matches?
results.ground_truth_note: Shahid Afridi (163 matches), Mohammad Hafeez (146), and Shoaib Malik top the list — Pakistan's classic all-rounders who both batted and bowled across their careers.

results.name: NQ15_quality_karachi_innings
results.question: Which players batted at Karachi AND scored at least 30 runs in those innings?
results.ground_truth_note: Younis Khan and Inzamam-ul-Haq have historically made many meaningful contributions at their home ground in Karachi.

results.name: NQ16_pak_test_allrounders
results.question: Which Pakistani players batted AND bowled in the same Test match?
results.ground_truth_note: Imran Khan (75 Tests), Wasim Akram (104 Tests), and Shahid Afridi are definitive Pakistan Test all-rounders. Shoaib Malik, Mushtaq Ahmed also feature.

results.name: NQ17_match_best_batting_bowling
results.question: Which players scored 50+ runs AND took at least 1 wicket in the same match?
results.ground_truth_note: Imran Khan's legendary performances (e.g., 117 & 6 wkts vs India 1982) should appear. Shahid Afridi and Wasim Akram also had such matches.

results.name: NQ18_rizwan_teammates
results.question: Who are Mohammad Rizwan's most frequent teammates?
results.ground_truth_note: Babar Azam, Shaheen Afridi, and Fakhar Zaman should top Rizwan's list — they are Pakistan's core T20I and ODI eleven since ~2019.

results.name: NQ19_most_connected_player
results.question: Which players have the most unique teammates in the dataset?
results.ground_truth_note: Long-serving Pakistan stalwarts (Shahid Afridi, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Shoaib Malik) played with the most diverse sets of teammates across eras.

results.name: NQ20_babar_shaheen_shared_matches
results.question: How many matches have Babar Azam and Shaheen Shah Afridi been in the same team?
results.ground_truth_note: Babar and Shaheen Shah Afridi have been Pakistan's captain-spearhead duo since 2020. Full corpus shows 100+ shared appearances across all formats.

results.name: NQ21_rpq_five_hops
results.question: How many deliveries are reachable within 5 hops of a starting delivery?
results.ground_truth_note: NEXT_DELIVERY is a linear chain (1:1). From any delivery that has at least 5 successors, reachable = 5. If the chain ends earlier, reachable < 5. The Cypher BFS and SQL WITH RECURSIVE must agree.

results.name: NQ22_rpq_exact_two_hops
results.question: Which delivery is exactly 2 hops after a starting delivery?
results.ground_truth_note: Since NEXT_DELIVERY is 1:1, there is at most one delivery 2 hops away. Cypher `*2` and SQL two-CTE expansion must return the same single row.

results.name: NQ23_rpq_teammates_3_hops
results.question: Who are the players reachable from Babar Azam within 3 TEAMMATES_WITH hops?
results.ground_truth_note: Babar's direct teammates span ~50+ players. Within 3 hops the cricket community is highly interconnected, so the result set is large. Cypher's node-deduplication and SQL's UNION (not UNION ALL) must agree.

results.name: NQ24_rpq_zero_or_more
results.question: How many deliveries (including itself) are reachable within 3 hops using zero-or-more?
results.ground_truth_note: `*0..3` includes depth-0 (the start node itself). Expected = 4 when the chain has >= 3 successors: start + 3 next deliveries. Tests the zero-or-more quantifier implementation.

results.name: NQ25_rpq_one_or_more_capped
results.question: How many deliveries are reachable within 8 hops using one-or-more?
results.ground_truth_note: This tests `*1..8` which is equivalent to `[:NEXT_DELIVERY+]` bounded to 8 hops. For a chain with >= 8 successors, reachable_plus = 8. The SQL uses the same bound. Engines must agree.

results.name: NQ26_rpq_scoring_within_10
results.question: How many of the next 10 deliveries after a starting ball scored runs?
results.ground_truth_note: Typically 4-7 of 10 deliveries score runs (strike rate ~40-70%). The RPQ traverses the chain and filters only scoring deliveries. Result must match between Cypher BFS+filter and SQL CTE+join.

results.name: NQ27_pak_teammates_within_2_hops
results.question: Which Pakistani players are within 2 teammate-hops of Babar Azam?
results.ground_truth_note: Direct PAK teammates of Babar = his entire XI. Within 2 hops = anyone who played with any of Babar's direct teammates. In a ~30 year corpus, nearly all PAK players qualify.

results.name: NQ28_rpq_boundary_deliveries
results.question: How many of the next 6 deliveries were boundaries (4+ runs for batter)?
results.ground_truth_note: Boundary rate in cricket is typically ~10-15% of deliveries. From 6 deliveries expect 0-2 boundaries. Tests `>=` comparison operator on target-side node property after RPQ.

results.name: NQ29_boundaryless_innings
results.question: Which players batted in the most innings without scoring any boundary?
results.ground_truth_note: Tailenders and specialist bowlers appear most often (low scores without boundaries). Openers rarely appear here. Tests AND composition of two equality comparisons (fours=0 AND sixes=0).

results.name: NQ30_non_pak_players
results.question: Which non-Pakistani players (opponents) have played against Pakistan, by country?
results.ground_truth_note: Should include players from AUS, ENG, IND, SA, NZ, WI, SL, ZIM, BAN. Tests `!=` operator on a string field.

results.name: NQ31_non_test_format_innings
results.question: Which players batted the most times in non-Test matches (T20 or ODI)?
results.ground_truth_note: Limited-overs specialists dominate. Shahid Afridi, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik played massive numbers of T20I and ODI innings for Pakistan.

results.name: NQ32_expensive_wicket_takers_t20
results.question: Which bowlers took wickets in T20s but conceded more than 30 runs in the same match?
results.ground_truth_note: Common in T20Is: a bowler takes wickets but still gets hit hard. Tests compound AND with >, > comparisons. Both engines must agree.

results.name: NQ33_highest_single_match_score
results.question: Which players recorded the highest single-match batting score?
results.ground_truth_note: Hanif Mohammad's 337 (1958) and Younis Khan's 313 are Pakistan's highest individual scores. In the cricsheet corpus (mostly modern matches), Azhar Ali 302* and Younis Khan's big knocks dominate.

results.name: NQ34_highest_match_batting_total
results.question: Which match had the highest combined batting total from all players?
results.ground_truth_note: High-scoring Test matches (700+ aggregate runs) and ODI run-fests (350+ per side) should appear. A 4-innings Test can accumulate 1000+ total batting runs.

results.name: NQ35_most_hosted_venues
results.question: Which venues have hosted the most matches, and where are they located?
results.ground_truth_note: Dubai International Cricket Stadium (100+ matches) is Pakistan's most-used neutral venue. National Stadium Karachi and Gaddafi Stadium Lahore lead the domestic list.
